subject.title: fix(gateway): add per-request cancellation to prevent late node.invoke dispatch

question: Should this fix implement the canonical issue's additive request-cancellation capability with authoritative pending/effecting/completed state?
rationale: Only maintainers can select the permanent Gateway protocol and security semantics for when cancellation may win and when node execution is already too late or indeterminate.

options.title: Redesign the request lifecycle
options.body: Implement explicit request-scoped cancellation and state ownership across client, server dispatch, approval handling, and node invocation.

options.title: Split out the protocol repair
options.body: Pause this implementation and leave the canonical issue open for a separate owner-led protocol change.

recommendation.title: Redesign the request lifecycle
recommendation.body: Implement explicit request-scoped cancellation and state ownership across client, server dispatch, approval handling, and node invocation.

likelyOwner.reason: The canonical issue defines the intended security boundary, and repository history shows the strongest ownership footprint across the affected Gateway lifecycle surfaces.
